about: Vectors for the revocation delta and the timestamp heartbeat (DEC-0054). An entry's hash, the next head, is the hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the entry without sig; entry 1's prev is the genesis, SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of {type: "revocation-delta/1", estate, sequence: 0}. Every signature is Ed25519 (RFC 8032) by an estate key, a hubKey the trusted revision certifies; the seeds reproduce them byte for byte. trust.record stands for the highest estate-record revision the machine verified and applied (its passkey signature is not part of these vectors); trust.at is the verifier's clock, a string a port parses (an unreadable one is no-clock). The keys are test keys generated for these vectors, never real credentials.
